test_case_name: Accept all cookies via the 'ACCONSENTO' button

intents.intent: Click the 'ACCONSENTO' button to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Access cookie preferences via the 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link

intents.intent: Click the 'PIÙ OPZIONI' link to open cookie preferences
And then check that the cookie preferences page or modal is displayed

test_case_name: Close the cookie banner using the close button

intents.intent: Click the 'Per accettare tutti i cookie, clicca sul pulsante “Acconsento”.' button to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Use the 'Passa al Contenuto' accessibility button

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Contenuto' button to skip to the main content
And then check that the focus is moved to the main content section

test_case_name: Use the 'Passa al Menù' accessibility button

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Menù' button to skip to the menu
And then check that the focus is moved to the menu section

test_case_name: Use the 'Passa al Piè di pagina' accessibility button

intents.intent: Click the 'Passa al Piè di pagina' button to skip to the footer
And then check that the focus is moved to the footer section

test_case_name: Open the header search input using the header search open button

intents.intent: Click the 'Header search open' button to display the search input
And then check that the 'Cerca' search input is visible

test_case_name: Toggle the header menu using the header menu toggler button

intents.intent: Click the 'Header menu toggler' button to open or close the main navigation menu
And then check that the main navigation menu is expanded or collapsed accordingly

test_case_name: Search for a term using the header search input and submit

intents.intent: Click the 'Header search open' button to display the search input
Type $name into the 'Cerca' search input
Click the 'Header search submit' button to perform the search
And then check that the search results page or section is displayed for $name

test_case_name: Cancel a search using the header search cancel button

intents.intent: Click the 'Header search open' button to display the search input
Type $name into the 'Cerca' search input
Click the 'Header search cancel' button to cancel the search
And then check that the search input is cleared or closed

test_case_name: Navigate to the homepage using the 'Homepage' breadcrumb link

intents.intent: Click the 'Homepage' link in the breadcrumb navigation
And then check that the homepage is displayed

test_case_name: Download the presentation using the 'SCARICA LA PRESENTAZIONE' link

intents.intent: Click the 'SCARICA LA PRESENTAZIONE' link to download the presentation
And then check that the presentation PDF is downloaded

test_case_name: Access 'Risultati 1sem.25' from the In primo piano section

intents.intent: Click the 'Risultati 1sem.25' link in the In primo piano section
And then check that the 'Risultati 1sem.25' page is displayed

test_case_name: Access 'Assemblea degli Azionisti' from the In primo piano section

intents.intent: Click the 'Assemblea degli Azionisti' link in the In primo piano section
And then check that the 'Assemblea degli Azionisti' page is displayed
Click the 'Statuto al 30 ottobre 2024' link to download the document
And then check that the Statuto PDF is downloaded
Click the 'Piano di Impresa 2022-2025' link to view the document
And then check that the 'Piano di Impresa 2022-2025' page or document is displayed
